shortTitle: Commentary: Diabetic Retinopathy Screening in India
longTitle: Commentary: Closing gaps in diabetic retinopathy screening in India using a deep learning system
summary:
Commentary discussing the potential of deep learning systems to address gaps in diabetic retinopathy screening in India.

This work highlights how artificial intelligence can revolutionize healthcare delivery in resource-limited settings. We examine the original research by Brant et al. and discuss implementation challenges.

Published in JAMA Network Open, this commentary provides insights for policymakers and healthcare providers.
